tools.name: haccp_options
tools.description: Lists every allowed answer of the HACCP Bulgaria questionnaire (facility types with prices, rooms, work steps, food groups). Call it first and use only these exact Bulgarian values in haccp_check and haccp_prepare_order.

tools.name: haccp_check
tools.description: For a food business in Bulgaria, returns which modules its HACCP system will contain (with the reason for each, in Bulgarian), the approximate number of pages and the final one-time price. Free, no personal or company data needed, creates nothing. Ask the person about their facility and food first;

tools.name: haccp_prepare_order
tools.description: Saves the answers as a draft for 7 days and returns a link. Give the link to the person: it opens the questionnaire already filled in, where they check every answer, add what is missing, see a free preview and pay themselves. You cannot order or pay; the payment and the legal consents are the person

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: haccp_prepare_order · Public sink: haccp_prepare_order.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: haccp_prepare_order · Public sink: haccp_prepare_order

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
